project.name: Smith Net
project.tagline: Deterministic job execution for contractors — works offline, ships invoices online.

moat.primary: deterministic-plan-compiler (internal: intent->summary_artifact->ledger SHA256-sealed pipeline with multi-authority validation)
moat.secondary: cord-based-state-model (internal: VectorClock + CordEntry/CordRepository + ReconciliationEngine for distributed conflict-free state)

trade_model.121_trade_picker: metadata field on profile + jobs; activates relevant trade pack when installed

external_marketing.SmithAI: LlamaInference + AISupervisor + AmbientRuleEngine on Android (Advanced tier)

vocabulary_mapping.rule: internal architecture/schema/API docs use code names; external/marketing/USP/UI use the marketing terms

backend.deployment: Hetzner Cloud behind Tailscale Funnel (trust proxy = 1)

phase_0_components.C-02: Role Engine (UserRole enum × Permission enum × ROLE_PERMISSIONS map)
phase_0_components.C-03: Schema & Boundary Engine (messageBus, channelRegistry, presenceManager, gatewayManager, wsHandler)
phase_0_components.C-05: Data Retention Core (auditLog.ts: 25+ actions, SHA256 per entry, retention policies)

backend.deterministic_pipeline: engagements -> intents -> intent_versions (draft/proposed/confirmed/superseded) -> summary_artifacts (sealed via SHA256 in computeHash) -> ledger_entries (immutable supersession chain)
backend.trade_extension_pattern: electricianTools.ts (CircuitDiagram, ElectricalChecklist with NEC/OSHA refs, MaterialEstimate, NECCheck) — replicate per trade as plumberTools.ts, hvacTools.ts, etc.

database_primary.name: self-hosted-postgres-on-hetzner
database_primary.key_migration: 002_full_schema.sql (intents, intent_versions, summary_artifacts, ledger_entries, proposals, invoice_links, jobs, time_entries, materials)

database_legacy.name: supabase-postgres
database_legacy.role: OFF-by-default (BuildConfig.SUPABASE_ENABLED=false). Used by desktop portal for auth + as a legacy chat path.
database_legacy.surface_dir_legacy: supabase-migrations/ (contains 002_add_media_support and 003_add_plan_management — the latter defines the @deprecated `plans` table being replaced by `intents`)

transports.online_realtime_PRIMARY: Hetzner-hosted ws WebSocket via ChatManager + GatewayClient (BACKEND_URL_PRIMARY)
transports.offline_p2p: android-mesh BoundaryEngine routing over Bluetooth + WiFi-Direct (MeshService)
transports.ephemeral_routing: broadcast-only via online relay; never persisted to cloud
transports.reconciliation: vector-clock-based (vectorClock.ts merge/compare/serialize) via reconciliationEngine.ts ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE; conflict-free distributed ordering

tiers.name: Free (Open)
includes: Smith Net branding on PDFs and emails

tiers.name: Solo
tiers.hero: PLAN Compiler (the moat) — deterministic plans that always run

tiers.name: Advanced
includes: SmithAI on-device assistant (full agent state machine: SLEEPING -> WAKING -> ALIVE)
AI proactive suggestions, summaries, plan authoring assist

monetization.ai_tier_floor: Advanced ($9.99) — AI is NOT in Solo, NOT in Free
monetization.solo_to_advanced_trigger_design: locked-AI-tab-CTA (when user opens AI Assistant section, show 'Upgrade to Advanced to enable SmithAI')
monetization.passive_distribution: Smith Net branding on every PDF footer + email signature

step_9_landing_page: out-of-scope (user explicitly skipped to focus on app infrastructure flow)
legacy_pricing_to_retire: backend/src/pricingTiers.ts implements solo/foreman/enterprise/nation × standard/hybrid with a 3-6-9 volume-discount pyramid. Replaced by Free/Solo/Advanced/Enterprise ladder per pricing-config.json. Retire in Step 11.
